entries.selectionPriorityBasis: Daily utility, English source lexical frequency proxy and original sentence identity; not a target-word frequency rank.

meanings.en: In his view, the domination by English is a threat to the heritage of humanity. It poses an even worse risk: This "single language" will lead to a "single thought" obsessed with money and consumerism.

entries.title: 二つの地図

meanings.en: I looked at two maps in a shop. One was cheap, but it had no station names. The other was more detailed than the cheap map. For a trip, a detailed map is worth buying.

entries.display: 友達と小さな店に入った。店には古い時計があるが、値段の表示がない。友達は「買う前に詳細な説明を聞こう」と言った。見た目より、ちゃんと動くことに価値がある。
entries.title: 古い時計

meanings.en: I entered a small shop with a friend. There was an old clock, but no price was shown. My friend said, “Let's ask for a detailed explanation before buying it.” Working properly matters more than its appearance.
meanings.zh: 我和朋友走进一家小店。店里有一只旧钟，但没有标价。朋友说：“买之前，先听听详细介绍吧。”比起外观，能正常走时更有价值。

metadata.spokenText: 友達と小さな店に入った。店には古い時計があるが、値段の表示がない。友達は「買う前に詳細な説明を聞こう」と言った。見た目より、ちゃんと動くことに価値がある。
